scope: Fresh source review only; current UI/mobile/publication acceptance remains with parent. No production files, browsers, running runtimes, databases or credentials changed.

findings.title: Do not apply the input 8 MiB limit to a generated PNG
findings.scenario: A supported source such as a JPEG is rendered at a permitted output size, but its PNG encoding exceeds 8 MiB. PNG size can exceed compressed JPEG source size. prepareExport runs the source-only inspectImage function on those generated bytes.
findings.effect: The preview and recipe work, but a valid permitted output cannot be exported. The user receives an input-size error even though the selected input meets the limit.

evidence.method: Real ImageSession with injected decoder/render/encoder, actual valid PNG framing and deflated synthetic random RGBA payload; no browser or production state touched.
evidence.limit_of_reproduction: Encoder injection deliberately isolates the output-validation gate; the random PNG does not claim to be the actual resize of the tiny source. This was not an actual-browser JPEG-to-PNG reproduction.

findings.smallest_fix: Give generated-PNG inspection a separately bounded byte budget appropriate to the supported 9 MP canvas output, while preserving the strict 8 MiB input limit. Do not simply remove all byte bounds. Continue checking PNG type, dimensions and hash.
findings.meaningful_test: A structurally valid generated PNG above 8 MiB and within output dimensions prepares successfully and its manifest hashes the exact bytes; the same byte length still fails source selection before decode. Add an actual browser high-entropy synthetic JPEG-to-PNG case when validating the fix.

findings.title: Claim the image-generation token when the demo is clicked
findings.scenario: Click SYN example while its fetch is held; select and successfully decode a different local synthetic file; then release the older demo fetch. Only the account/network epoch is compared, and manual file selection does not change it.
findings.effect: The older demo invokes loadFile after the newer manual selection and replaces that chosen source and geometry. Existing prepared URLs also remain usable during the demo fetch because the new image intent has not invalidated them.

evidence.method: Imported current app.js into an in-process fake DOM with only imports/dependency injection and a review hook transformed in memory; actual ImageSession and geometry modules, deferred fake fetch and synthetic Files.

findings.smallest_fix: At demo click immediately invalidate/record the current image generation and update disabled state. Before calling loadFile after fetch, require both the same account epoch and same image generation. Later manual selection, settings, recipe selection or identity changes must invalidate it. Preserve recipe selection at intent time.
findings.meaningful_test: Hold demo fetch, load a newer local file, release demo and assert source hash, geometry and downloads remain those of the newer file. Also assert demo intent immediately invalidates existing prepared URLs.

findings.title: Do not discard a current file UI update after a same-account metadata refresh
findings.scenario: Start a file decode with old width field 777, refresh metadata while decoding, then finish decode. refresh increments epoch; ImageSession still accepts the source for the same identity, while loadFile returns early at ticket!==epoch before fillSettings and recipe cleanup. visibilitychange can produce the same epoch change.
findings.effect: The accepted current source/preview is shown at width 1000 while the numeric input still says 777. Preparing export silently applies the stale control value. A pending saved-recipe reopen can likewise leave stale controls/title and the pending-recipe block after its bytes have already been accepted.

evidence.method: Same isolated current-app/actual-ImageSession harness, deferred decode and synthetic same-account session/state responses.

findings.smallest_fix: Use image-intent/identity generation for file completion rather than the metadata request epoch. Reconcile controls/title and pending recipe only if this load remains the current accepted image operation. Same-account metadata refresh must not suppress that completion; newer files, logout and identity changes must still suppress it.
findings.meaningful_test: Defer decode, perform same-account refresh, complete decode and assert form fields equal current accepted settings. Repeat for saved-recipe reopen and require title/pending state completion. Retain tests proving logout/new-file completion cannot update old UI.

findings.title: First-file failure claims a previous valid result was preserved
findings.scenario: Reject a corrupt file on a fresh editor with no prior bitmap or preview.
findings.effect: The message asserts a last valid result was preserved although none exists.
findings.smallest_fix: Select the failure message based on whether a prior valid source/preview exists.
findings.meaningful_test: First-file failure versus replacement failure must produce different truthful messages.

findings.title: Common input errors expose English implementation text inside RU/KK UI
findings.scenario: Reject EXIF/magic/size, enter an invalid crop or fail export encoding.
findings.effect: Localized guidance is followed by raw English parser/controller messages; export handler can show the raw message alone. The user may not understand the required correction.
findings.smallest_fix: Map stable error codes to RU/KK task messages; keep technical detail separate if needed.
findings.meaningful_test: In each locale, common format, bounds and export failures show actionable localized text without raw implementation wording.

validation.reportedByImplementer: 49 Node tests and seven isolated browser pixel cases passed previously; not rerun and not represented as independent current proof.
validation.independent: Three narrow in-process reproductions above; one intentional in-memory mutation of crop OR to AND made the existing one-axis overflow test fail (1 selected test, expected failure), demonstrating that particular regression is detected. Original product source was never altered.
validation.runtime: Narrow pure-JS reproductions used locally resolved Node v22.23.1; no SQLite or HTTP runtime execution. This is not a substitute for the supported Node24 suite.

decisionsNotBugs: Header parser checks bounded framing and mandatory browser dimension agreement; it is intentionally not a complete compressed-image validator or decoder security certification.
Shared authenticated staff metadata is explicitly the contract, so absence of tenant isolation is not a defect.
Immutable recipes contain declared metadata and cannot certify actual pixels, rights, authorship or download completion.
Separate stable PNG and manifest links are a recorded delivery decision, not a regression.
200 recipe/1000 command limits are bounded local-workspace decisions; archive does not reclaim immutable history.
declinedToJudge: Actual full UI/mobile/native keyboard behavior, localized visual quality, touch or assistive technology; no browser was touched.
Browser decoder security, adversarial compressed ICC/entropy behavior, exact peak memory or low-memory mobile reliability; no certification inferred from 16 MP/9 MP caps.
Pixel interpolation correctness beyond the previously reported seven cases; crop scratch fix was inspected but not rerun in a browser.
Existing databases, private credentials, runtime restart preservation, backups on disk, release CI, public ZIP and publication state; deliberately untouched.
External demand, asset rights outside reviewed original code/declared synthetic fixtures and production deployment hardening.
